question: Why was I charged $15 on April 6, 2026?

facts: The $15.00 was an overdraft fee on the checking account on April 6, 2026.
A $25.86 card purchase at Corner Grocer overdrew the account by more than the $50.00 cushion.
The 2026 fee schedule charges $15.00 per item only when the overdraft is more than $50.00.

notes: The demo's headline question. Trap: the same day has a $5.40 foreign-transaction fee on the card (Kyoto Rail Pass); a good answer explains the $15, not that. A weak answer cites the deposit agreement's general fee clause instead of the schedule's cushion rule.

question: How much did I spend on groceries in May 2026?

facts: Two grocery purchases in May 2026: FreshFields Market and Corner Grocer.
Together they come to $259.98, spent (money out).

notes: The total must come from the calculator, never the model's arithmetic. Wrong answers: a negative figure ("-$259.98"), one purchase only, or April's or June's groceries mixed in.

question: Why was my out-of-network ATM fee $3.50 in May when it used to be $3.00?

facts: The out-of-network ATM fee rose from $3.00 to $3.50 when the 2026 fee schedule took effect on February 1, 2026.
The May 13, 2026 fee was charged under the 2026 schedule; the earlier $3.00 fees under the 2025 one.

numbers.what: an ATM fee under the 2025 schedule
the new fee in the schedule
the old fee in the schedule

notes: Version trap: the 2025 schedule ($3.00) is superseded but still loaded. A wrong answer quotes $3.00 as today's fee, or says the bank made a mistake. Both versions' fees are in this customer's data.
